decision_cruda.rationale: LH-02 is down at E569-07. Radio and CMMS agree, so the CONFIRM rule does not apply. The likely repair is 13:20. LH-10 is idle at the workshop, so lending it costs nothing and it takes 0.49 h to arrive. At 27.5 t/h from about 09:50 it can muck the 168 t (10.5 g/t, about 56.7 oz) by 17:00. Este has no truck limit and its stockpile is nearly empty. Without the loan the stope would sit idle until 13:20. I'm not taking loaders from other stopes or from development headings, because the idle loader covers this.
